title: COA: 33 health care facilities get OP's P4.22-B socio-civic projects fund
summary: Thirty-three health care facilities received the Office of the President’s (OP) Socio-Civic Projects Fund (SCPF) amounting to P4.22 billion from 2024 to 2025, the Commission on Audit (COA) said.
